title: Graph representations
summary: Adjacency lists, matrices and edge lists: what each costs and when to use it.

questions.prompt: A road network has 100,000 places and 300,000 roads. Which representation fits?
options: An adjacency list: memory grows with places + roads
An edge list, searched in full for each place's neighbours

questions.prompt: With an adjacency matrix, how long does it take to check whether there is an edge from u to v?
How much memory does an adjacency list need for V vertices and E edges?
True or false: in an undirected graph stored as an adjacency list, each edge usually appears twice.
